mapper.select: SELECT c.*, s.name AS school_name, g.name AS grade_name, t.name AS head_teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student st WHERE st.class_id = c.id AND st.deleted = 0) AS student_count FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN school s ON c.school_id = s.id LEFT JOIN grade g ON c.grade_id = g.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.head_teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0
